question: Has Kevala been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Kevala now?
markdown:
Depending on which company named
Kevala
you mean,
there are different acquisition and ownership updates
1. Kevala AI (Healthcare / Senior Living Workforce Platform)
Acquisition/Merger:
The Seattle-based health-tech and AI workforce platform
Kevala
was acquired by
Residex AI
(backed by private equity firm
Accel-KKR
) in August 2025. Additionally, in June 2025, Kevala’s separate per diem healthcare staffing business was taken over by
StaffDNA
Current Ownership:
It is now owned and operated as part of the
Residex
labor optimization and senior care platform.
Staffing Industry Analysts
2. Kevala Analytics (Power Grid Data & Energy Analytics)
Acquisition/Merger:
The San Francisco-based energy analytics firm
Kevala
has
not
been acquired or merged; it remains an independent private company.
Current Ownership:
It is privately held, led by founder and CEO Aram Shumavon, and backed by investors such as C5 Capital and Thin Line Capital.
